tasks.source_text: 159°. 任何将空间映射成自身的保距映射是空间变换吗？

requests.request: Decide whether any space-to-itself distance-preserving map is a transformation.
requests.answer: Yes, in the source's injective sense; it is also onto in Euclidean R3 by a separate derivation.
proof: If f(M)=f(N), preserved distance gives |MN|=|f(M)f(N)|=0, so M=N.
For onto, take b=f(0), u_i=f(e_i)-b. Pairwise distances make the u_i an orthonormal basis.
Writing y=f(x)-b, the distances to 0 and e_i give y dot u_i=x_i, so f(x)=b+Qx with Q orthogonal.
Every z has preimage Q^T(z-b).
conditions: Space is the source's three-dimensional Euclidean space.
Equal-input and zero-distance cases are included.
This does not establish onto for arbitrary source-injective transformations.
